description: The mailTabs API allows to interact with Thunderbird's main mail tab (a.k.a 3-pane tab).

events.description: Fired when the displayed folder changes in any mail tab.
events.name: onDisplayedFolderChanged

events.description: Fired when the selected messages change in any mail tab.
events.name: onSelectedMessagesChanged

functions.description: Gets all mail tabs that have the specified properties, or all mail tabs if no properties are specified.
functions.name: query

active.description: Whether the tabs are active in their windows.

currentWindow.description: Whether the tabs are in the current window.

lastFocusedWindow.description: Whether the tabs are in the last focused window.

windowId.description: The ID of the parent window, or $(ref:windows.WINDOW_ID_CURRENT) for the current window.

functions.description: Get the $(ref:mailTabs.MailTab) properties of a mail tab.
functions.name: get

parameters.description: ID of the requested mail tab. Throws if the requested <var>tabId</var> does not belong to a mail tab.
parameters.name: tabId

functions.description: Creates a new mail tab. Standard tab properties can be adjusted via $(ref:tabs.update) after the mail tab has been created. A new mail window can be created via $(ref:windows.create).
functions.name: create

parameters.description: Details about the created mail tab. Will contain the ID of the new tab.
parameters.name: mailTab

functions.description: Modifies the properties of a mail tab. Properties that are not specified in <var>updateProperties</var> are not modified.
functions.name: update

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

parameters.description: Details about the updated mail tab.
parameters.name: mailTab

functions.description: Lists the messages in the current view, honoring sort order and filters as used in the UI. Sort order of the returned messages can be overridden via the <var>options</var> parameter
functions.name: getListedMessages

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

sortOrder.description: The sort order for the returned messages. Ignored if <var>sortType</var> is not specified.

sortType.description: Specifies how the returned messages should be sorted. This does not change the actual sort of the displayed messages. Default sort order is <var>descending</var>, if not specified otherwise. Returning sorted messages is faster than manually sorting the messages afterwards, but slower than returning the messages in their original order.

functions.description: Lists the selected folders in the folder pane. Does not include folders which are context-clicked, but not selected. The context-clicked folders are always returned by the $(ref:menus.onClicked) event of the menus API.
functions.name: getSelectedFolders

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

functions.description: Lists the selected messages in the current folder. Includes messages in collapsed threads. Does not include messages which are context-clicked, but not selected. The context-clicked messages are always returned by the $(ref:menus.onClicked) event of the menus API.
functions.name: getSelectedMessages

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

functions.description: Selects none, one or multiple messages. Opens collapsed threads to show the selection, if required.
functions.name: setSelectedMessages

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

parameters.description: The IDs of the messages, which should be selected. The mail tab will switch to the folder of the selected messages. Throws if they belong to different folders. Array can be empty to deselect any currently selected message.
parameters.name: messageIds

functions.description: Sets the Quick Filter user interface based on the options specified.
functions.name: setQuickFilter

parameters.description: Defaults to the active tab of the current window.
parameters.name: tabId

contact.description: Shows only messages from people in the address book.

show.description: Shows or hides the Quick Filter bar.

tags.description: Shows only messages with tags on them.

text.description: Shows only messages matching the supplied text.

types.description: A supported folder mode in the folder pane.

annotations.text: Show only folders with unread messages.

displayedFolder.description: The folder displayed in the mail tab. The <permission>accountsRead</permission> permission is required for this property to be included.

folderMode.description: The folder mode of the currently displayed folder.

folderModesEnabled.description: The enabled folder modes in the folder pane, and their sort order.

folderPaneVisible.description: Whether the folder pane is visible or not.

groupType.description: Grouping type of the message list.

annotations.text: Messages are grouped by the current sort type.

layout.description: The arrangement of the folder pane, message list pane, and message display pane.

annotations.text: The standard layout with the folder pane on the left, and the message list and message display stacked on the right.
The vertical layout with the folder pane, message list, and message display side by side in three columns.
The wide layout with the folder pane and message list side by side on top, and the message display on the bottom.

messagePaneVisible.description: Whether the message pane is visible or not.

sortOrder.description: The sort order of the message list.

sortType.description: The primary sort column of the message list.

annotations.text: Sort by account, grouping messages belonging to the same account.
Sort by the Message-ID header, a unique identifier assigned by the sending server.
Sort by thread, grouping messages that belong to the same conversation.

displayedFolderId.description: Sets the folder displayed in the mail tab. Requires the <permission>accountsRead</permission> permission. The previous message selection in the given folder will be restored, if any.

folderMode.description: Sets the currently used folder mode, enabling it if required. If used without also specifying <var>displayedFolder</var>, the currently selected folder is re-selected in the new folder mode, if possible.

folderModesEnabled.description: Set the enabled folder modes in the folder pane, and their sort order.

folderPaneVisible.description: Shows or hides the folder pane.

groupType.description: Grouping type of the message list.

annotations.text: Messages are grouped by the current sort type.

layout.description: Sets the arrangement of the folder pane, message list pane, and message display pane. Setting a layout will be applied to all mail tabs.

annotations.text: The standard layout with the folder pane on the left, and the message list and message display stacked on the right.
The vertical layout with the folder pane, message list, and message display side by side in three columns.
The wide layout with the folder pane and message list side by side on top, and the message display on the bottom.

messagePaneVisible.description: Shows or hides the message display pane.

sortOrder.description: Sorts the list of messages. <var>sortType</var> must also be given.

sortType.description: Sorts the list of messages. <var>sortOrder</var> must also be given.

annotations.text: Sort by account, grouping messages belonging to the same account.
Sort by the Message-ID header, a unique identifier assigned by the sending server.
Sort by thread, grouping messages that belong to the same conversation.

author.description: Shows messages where <var>text</var> matches the author.

body.description: Shows messages where <var>text</var> matches the message body.

recipients.description: Shows messages where <var>text</var> matches the recipients.

subject.description: Shows messages where <var>text</var> matches the subject.

text.description: String to match against the <var>recipients</var>, <var>author</var>, <var>subject</var>, or <var>body</var>.
